judgments.concern: Pocket-opening body depth on the pose: for each successful call of estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, width and height written on the stage-2 outcome and on PalletPoseStamped are the factory face that call already matches, params.pallet_width_m 1.20 m and params.pallet_height_m 0.14 m, and the search template stays that face. Depth is the median far-side length through the two fork openings the prototype already cuts. Of the points sample_face_points already returned, keep those that, after the plane projection is translated by the opposite of best_pose's tx and ty and rotated by the opposite of the rotation rotate_proto_into applies, fall inside either pocket rectangle (centres at plus and minus pocket_centre_offset_m, sides pocket_width_m and pocket_height_m) and whose signed point_to_plane_distance is less than the negation of plane_inlier_threshold_m. Each contribution is the negation of that signed distance, and depth_m is the median. has_body_depth is true only when that set is non-empty. When the set is empty, has_body_depth is false, publish_pose still publishes the pose with the factory face width and height, and depth_m is a body length only when has_body_depth is true. The fields sit on the outcome and, after input_depth_stamp, on PalletPoseStamped. A failed estimate publishes no PalletPoseStamped. The two early returns in on_pair stay silent. Stage 2 still runs once, on the one candidate select_detection already chooses. The proposal is that factory face plus the median far-side length through those two openings, with the missing-body flag. It does not restate dimension_error_m (the named penalty on pallet width, height, and depth in metres) or latency_ms (the named penalty on measured inference latency).

Factory-floored silhouette and pocket opening: for each successful estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, width and height are the spans of obs_points_2d in the prototype axes after shifting by minus best_pose.tx and best_pose.ty and rotating by minus best_pose.theta_rad. The published width is the greater of that silhouette width and params.pallet_width_m, and the published height is the greater of that silhouette height and params.pallet_height_m, so a crop that falls short of the factory 1.20 m by 0.14 m face stays the factory face the match used. Depth is the median absolute far-side length of samples from sample_face_points whose plane projection falls inside either pocket the pose already places (pocket_width_m, pocket_height_m, pocket_centre_offset_m) and whose signed plane distance lies on the far side of the camera-facing normal by more than plane_inlier_threshold_m. The face-centre range stays the pose position. When no pocket sample is on that far side, has_body_depth is false and depth_m is not given as 0, while width_m and height_m are still published. When the set is nonempty, has_body_depth is true. A failed estimate publishes no PalletPoseStamped. The two early returns in on_pair stay silent. Stage 2 still runs once, on the one candidate select_detection already chooses. The proposal is that floor against the matched factory face and the median far-side length inside the pockets. It does not restate dimension_error_m or latency_ms.

Published admission split: for the class-matched detections in one capture, select_stage2_subset ranks that DetectionCandidate list with the strategy select_detection already implements, by the first-maximum rule std::max_element already uses, so a tie keeps the earlier candidate and the later tied candidate stays deferred. It admits at most the count the caller passes, in that rank order, and places every candidate it does not admit into deferred, preserving their order in the candidate list. Each candidate keeps its source_index. Stage2Admission holds those two vectors. An empty candidate list returns both vectors empty, and an unknown strategy throws. The pose node calls it with its detection_selection strategy and a count of one, so stage 2 still estimates that single admitted pallet. The admitted source index and the deferred source indices are written on PalletPoseStamped after input_depth_stamp. When the estimate fails, no PalletPoseStamped is published and the same two lists are written on the failure diagnostic, which is the only result that path publishes. The two early returns that publish nothing stay as they are. The proposal is those two admission vectors, ordered by that first-maximum rule, on the pose result and on the failure diagnostic. It does not restate dimension_error_m or latency_ms.
